acceptanceCriteria: Diagnostics identify canonical/backend status disagreement without granting verification authority.
Already human-Verified canonical records can synchronize established GitHub status labels.
The 29 audited stale labels are reconciled only after local behavior passes and live access is available.
component: AirframeCore backend policy, AICockpit, AgileCockpit, and controlled live synchronization for R-11.
componentsAffected: AirframeCore backend policy, AICockpit, AgileCockpit, and controlled live synchronization for R-11.

rationale:
Canonical status and GitHub status labels drift apart, leaving 29 audited stale labels with no supported way to reconcile them. This task diagnoses disagreement and synchronizes labels for already human-Verified records, without letting synchronization confer verification authority.

Constraint: Only prior canonical human verification authorizes a Verified backend label.
testSteps: Reconciliation tests, dry-run report, and remote-change log for all synchronized artifacts.
